en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large neoclassical-style building with multiple arches and balconies identified as the Law Courts in Freetown. People in early 20th‑century dress walk in front of the building and along a street lined with a large tree. There is printed caption text in the top right corner and along the right edge, plus a vertical handwritten message in ink.
